bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; code=80; pg(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; a=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts WHERE created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours'") || exit 101; test "$a" -gt 0 || code=$((code+1)); b=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM announcement_posts WHERE room_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours'") || exit 102; test "$b" -gt 0 || code=$((code+2)); c=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND a.created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours' AND d.status='sent'") || exit 103; test "$c" -gt 0 || code=$((code+4)); d=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND a.created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours' AND d.status IN ('sending','needs_reconcile')") || exit 104; test "$d" -gt 0 || code=$((code+8)); e=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts WHERE created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_posts a WHERE a.room_id=room_posts.room_id)") || exit 105; test "$e" -gt 0 || code=$((code+16)); f=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM announcement_posts a WHERE a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND a.created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours' AND a.status='draft'") || exit 106; test "$f" -gt 0 || code=$((code+32)); exit "$code"
